propositions: rebar comment silently stores flag-like tokens (e.g. '--body-file', '--body') as the literal comment body and exits 0, discarding the intended content

commands with positional body arguments (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) accept flag tokens as body values instead of rejecting them, causing data loss with no user-visible error signal
comment bodies beginning with '-' can be escaped using '--' (e.g. `rebar comment <id> -- "-value"`) to distinguish deliberate dashes from flag tokens
surplus positional arguments beyond the minimum required are silently dropped via args[:min_args] slicing, compounding the silent-loss failure mode
multiple independent sessions have independently reached for a '--body-file' option that does not exist, suggesting the documented shell-substitution idiom may not match user expectations
